questions.q: What is the core difference between GlideModal and GlideDialogWindow?
options: GlideDialogWindow is deprecated and GlideModal replaces it entirely
GlideModal shows a simple message/confirmation with no custom UI Page; GlideDialogWindow loads a full UI Page's interactive content inside a modal
GlideModal runs only on the server; GlideDialogWindow runs only on the client
There is no real difference; they are aliases for the same object
questions.explain: GlideModal is for lightweight messages; GlideDialogWindow is for displaying a full custom UI Page's content inside a modal overlay.

questions.explain: GlideDialogWindow's constructor argument is the name of the UI Page record to render inside the dialog.

questions.q: What does `setPreference('sysparm_id', g_form.getUniqueValue())` accomplish before `dialog.render()` is called?
options: It changes the dialog's title to the record's sys_id
It has no effect unless the dialog is a GlideModal instead
It passes the current record's sys_id into the dialog so the UI Page it opens can look up or reference that record
It permanently saves the record's sys_id to the database
questions.explain: setPreference() passes a named value into the opened UI Page, where it can be read as a sysparm_ parameter — here, the current record's unique ID.

questions.q: A UI Action just needs to show the message "This will close every related task" with an OK button, no custom fields. Which API fits best, and why?
options: GlideDialogWindow, because GlideModal cannot display any text
GlideModal, because it shows a simple popup message without requiring a dedicated UI Page to be built and maintained
Neither; this requires the browser's native alert() instead
GlideDialogWindow, because every dialog must load a UI Page regardless of content
questions.explain: GlideModal exists precisely so a simple message or confirmation doesn't require building and maintaining a UI Page.

questions.q: Why would building a GlideDialogWindow-based dialog be the wrong choice for a one-line delete confirmation?
options: It is actually always the correct choice over GlideModal
GlideDialogWindow only works on list views, never on forms
GlideDialogWindow cannot be triggered from a UI Action
It requires creating and maintaining a UI Page record for content that's really just a single message, which GlideModal already handles
questions.explain: Using GlideDialogWindow for a simple message means maintaining an extra UI Page record that a lighter GlideModal call would have avoided entirely.
